settings.title: Logging in
settings.passwordsOffText: Only keys will work. Make sure you can log in with a key before you continue, or you may lock yourself out.

port.intro: Moving SSH keeps the old port open for a while, so you can check the new one first.
port.title: Move SSH to port {port}?
port.text: SSH will listen on both the old and the new port. Log in on the new port to check it works (and open it in your cloud provider's security group). The old port closes automatically after {minutes} minutes, or when you close it.
port.pending: SSH listens on port {old} and on the new port {port}. The old port closes in {time}.
port.finishText: Only the new port stays open. Make sure you have logged in on it.

keys.empty: This user has no authorized keys.
keys.deleteText: The key {fingerprint} can no longer log in as {user}.
keys.rootReadOnly: Root's keys cannot be changed while root access is turned off in the settings.
